messages.content: 流行歌曲中最常見的和弦是什麼？

function.name: music_theory_primary_triads
function.description: Get the primary triads for a given key signature. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

key_signature.description: The key signature to calculate the primary triads for.

include_inversions.description: Whether or not to include inversions in the returned triads.

message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "流行歌曲中最常見的和弦是什麼？" meaning "What are the most common chords in pop songs?" They want an answer. We can provide a general explanation: In pop music, the most common chords are I, V, vi, IV in major keys, and i, v, VI, III, VII in minor keys. Also mention the use of secondary dominants, borrowed chords, etc. Provide examples. Also mention that the I–V–vi–IV progression is extremely common. Also mention that the ii–V–I progression is common in jazz but less so in pop. Also mention that the use of the dominant seventh, minor seventh chords, etc. Provide a list of chords that appear frequently: major triads, minor triads, dominant seventh chords, minor seventh chords, major seventh chords. Also mention that the most common chord functions: tonic, subdominant, dominant. Provide a short explanation. Also mention that the most common chords in pop are the I, IV, V, vi, ii, iii, and sometimes the bVII. Provide examples: C major: C, G, Am, F. Also mention that the "pop progression" often uses I–V–vi–IV. Provide a short answer.
